TORA produced zero INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT holds this shift, but the identity axis was opaque on TORA-20260703-0025 (username, privilege_level, user_type all unknown at triage). notes: VERA REFINED all 25 of TORA's escalated hypotheses — zero CONFIRMED-as-stated, zero REFUTED.
